title: Parallel Stars — Original Song (Synthesized Vocals)
description:
Two synthesized voices — one high, one low — trading verses and meeting an octave apart in the chorus.

A note on the voice: this is a fully synthesized vocalise — a wordless voice built from sine harmonics and formant resonances, singing vowels rather than lyrics. No vocal sample libraries were used; the voice, like every instrument here, is generated from scratch.

88 BPM · original composition · synthesized voice & instruments.

— Written, sung (synthetically) and mixed for this channel.
